Your data is always encrypted on a device and in a cloud with a strong 256-bit Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). This algorithm is used by the U.S. Government for protection of a top secret information. AES is also widely adopted worldwide and became the de facto encryption standard.

AUTOFILL IN CHROME

AUTOMATIC DATA IMPORT

Open AppLock, Protect, Unlock Settings

2)How to open hidden AppLock?
Please update to the latest version and then try the following four methods to open hidden AppLock:

Open your Gallery, select a picture, click the share button. Find "Open AppLock" and click it.

AppLock doesn’t use Accessibility Service to collect any data. We only use it to monitor foreground apps.

Encryption is key to the NordLocker package. Secure cloud storage utilizes end-to-end encryption to ensure that files are protected from snooping or accidental exposure.

State-of-the-art encryption ensures that it is impossible to access any of your private data. Everything you encrypt and share with others can only be accessed by you and the people you trust.
